reviewed_interpretation: The single authoritative I028 execution is valid: all 17,046 raw disagreement targets are represented exactly once, the fixed eight-prior-reference observation boundary is unchanged, and NS/VAD shipping mirrors are exact. The dominant readiness failure is temporal ordering rather than a lack of later ordinary-noise observations. Across all 168 target cases, 139 cases (82.74%) see the first disagreement target before the eight-reference pool is ready, and 98 cases (58.33%) see the first target before even the first ordinary-noise reference. The median first target occurs at frame 4 from warmup, while the median first ordinary-noise reference occurs at frame 10 and the median eight-reference readiness point at frame 43; the median readiness delay from first target is 36 frames. This affects oracle-speech substantially more than oracle-noise: 36.37% of speech targets are pre-ready versus 12.93% of noise targets, and 1,290 of 3,113 pre-ready speech targets (41.44%) have zero prior ordinary-noise references at target time. Cafeteria is the clearest amplification: 54.46% of speech targets are pre-ready, 12 of 18 cases have first target before first reference, 15 of 18 have first target before readiness, the median first target/reference/ready frames are 5/24/44, and the median readiness delay is 41 frames. Moreover 289 of 574 cafeteria pre-ready speech targets (50.35%) have zero prior references; the median prior-reference count for those pre-ready speech targets is 0, while the median across all cafeteria speech targets is only 6. Cafeteria later accumulates usable ordinary-noise observations (median 56 per target case), and its median reference inter-arrival is still 1 frame, so the primary problem is delayed initial availability and condition-specific long gaps/order, not a uniformly slow steady-state reference cadence. I028 therefore selects no readiness threshold, reference mechanism, component, mapping, candidate or shipping change.

hypothesis_review.explanation: Most target cases begin producing disagreement before the fixed eight-reference pool is ready, and more than half begin before the first ordinary-noise reference. Cafeteria shifts the first ordinary-noise reference later and leaves many speech targets at prior_reference_count=0. However, once references are present, the median inter-arrival is 1 frame globally and in cafeteria, so the evidence points to startup/ordering and intermittent gaps rather than uniformly slow steady-state reference arrival.

proposed_followup_hypothesis.rationale: Use entirely fresh public-development authority to test whether an independent, metadata-matched ordinary-noise donor reference can be available causally from target start without changing the fixed eight-frame same-case observation boundary or using target-future frames. Before any component counterfactual, compare preregistered donor-reference mean/concentration/gap summaries against each target case's own later ready-phase ordinary-noise reference only as a retrospective agreement benchmark. Use disjoint donor/target cases and fixed matching dimensions (noise domain first, then preregistered scenario/SNR/reverb compatibility where available), report match error and donor coverage globally and per domain, with special attention to cafeteria. The purpose is feasibility of a causally available diagnostic reference, not selection of a shipping reference source, component, mapping, threshold or candidate.
required_gates: donor selection uses only preregistered metadata and never target outputs
no target-future frame contributes to the causal donor reference
target case later ready-phase reference is retrospective benchmark only
global and per-noise-domain donor coverage and agreement reported
prohibited: post-hoc lowering of the eight-frame readiness threshold

verification_limits: I028 is development-only and uses oracle labels to define diagnostic target/reference populations; timing distributions describe the constructed public-development authority and are not calibrated product-environment rates.
The fixed eight-prior-reference count remains an observation boundary only. I028 does not compare, tune or justify any alternative readiness threshold.
first_ready_frame and frames_until_ready are retrospective diagnostics; future readiness timing is never a causal input available to the target frame.
The conclusion that initial temporal ordering dominates does not prove that any specific alternative reference mechanism is valid or shippable.
Cafeteria later accumulates ordinary-noise references, but the evidence does not establish that those later same-case references may be used causally for earlier targets.

No component counterfactual, component ranking, mapping selection, source candidate, validation-grade, blind, hosted-real, HIL, product-certification, confirmation, source-merge or release authority was consumed.
